A nice co-op shooter.
The atmosphere and sounds are great.
Upgrading your gear becomes addictive.
Fun with people but playing alone it can get stale.
Shooting feels good and the AI is smart enough to ambush you.
OVER IN ONE WEEK, 5 GUNS TO PLAY WITH IS BAD BAD BAD. NEEDS MORE GUNS.
Ok i was mistaken. i did not talk to NPC on the Endeavour to enable the next mission. certain missions seem to be grayed out but i guess its just a highlight cursor thing.
great game, only problem is similar to predator: hunting grounds, there just arent a whole lot of players. definitely recommend you try it out, if you have friends to play with maybe,

I wouldn't pay full price for it but for £20ish I think that's a fair price, Game play can get repetitive quickly, but I think its that type of game. fast shooter, hordes of enemies to kill. Best played with friends, the AI Bots are ok but not the best especially on the higher difficulties. match making havent tried yet, Great game for any Alien fan great sounds and an eerie atmosphere. 5 classes/ load outs to choose from - Gunner, Demolition, Tech, Doc and Phalanx all have different abilities.
It's a fun co-op shooter in the Aliens universe. Brings back great memories from when I played Aliens vs Predator with my friends over modem back in the days.,
Captures the feel of the ALIEN franchise at a reduced price. Could use more boss battles but no complaints.

This game is almost very good. It could have been very good. It may still be very good if they continue to add content, but i'm afraid with how quickly the initial limited content gets old, the sudden lack of player interest, and probably a steep drop off of income this may be yet another opportunity lost. It's really ashame that the history of Aliens games made has completely overlooked one of the very first ones made. Aliens Online was a game from the mid(ish) 90's that had been part of what was called Gamestorm. They had quite a few amazingly fun games . Air Warrior, A mage battle type game, a Gangsters strategy game, and a cult favorite to many including myself - Aliens Online. In that game you could play Alien or Marine and gather in the lobby and see what new ' hives' started filling with players and whom. Once the marines got into the hive an alien player could take over as the Queen. The players got to know each other very well and it created a tight community. It was rather cool and rather sad because it was one of many games that...the evil EA has erased from being able to play. ( Alpha Centauri - an amazing sci-fi strategy game being another). It's ashame  with how much effort  Cold Iron studios put into recreating the look , the feel, and the sounds of the Alien franchise yet the main framework of what brings people back to playing multiplayer games is ....other people. You can't even chat to others in this game. Let us play alien characters in a versus marine mode.  Let us chat in some sort of lobby and create an in game community. Make this franchise....great again !
